tei:div.tei:p: (463)༄༅// rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i las byang 'dod 'jo'i snye ma zhes bya ba zhugs so// (464)

bcom ldan 'das dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dponal pad+ma 'byung gnas nyid/ mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis spyan drangs nas brag dmar 'om bu'i tshal du bzhugs su gsol te za 'og gi gdan bting*/ na bza' rdo rje'i gsang lam sku la gsol te/ gser g.yu'i maṇ+ḍal dang*/ gser skyogs kyi nang du 'bras chang drang nas zhus pa/ slob dpon chen po lags/ khyed ni dus gsum thams cad ma bsgribs sa ler gzigs pas dus bzang ngan ji ltar 'byung zhus pas/ slob dpon gyis gsungs pa/ rje lhags dus kyi tha mar sleb tsa na/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyi ma ltar 'grib/ dmu rgod kyi sems can me ltar 'bar zhing rlung ltar 'tshubs/ dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus su/ gdon ni klu dang rgyal bsen gnod/ nad ni mdze dang smyo 'bogs dar/ gnyan dang drang srong gi nad kha 'phyo/ 'phral du rtsog la phugs su ngan pa zhig 'ong gsungs/ de'i tshe 'di dag la phan pa'i thabs tshegs chung la don che ba/ (465)bya bla la 'grub mgyogs pa zhig gsung 'tshal zhus pas/ gu rus zhal nas/ kyai lha sras nyon cig bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'dir/ 'dzam gling gru chad kyi na shos yin te/ bod yul mun pa'i smag rum dang 'dra ba 'dir 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs rjes 'dul ba las zhi bas mi thul ba rnams la dpal rta 'grin du sprul nas btul ba yin/ de la dus ngan snyigs ma'i dus su/ sa bdag klu gnyan rgyal bsen 'dul ba'i gnyen po ni/ rta mgrin nag po khros pa'i khro bo 'di yin no/ 'di shin tu gnyan pas sngags dang ting nge 'dzin dang gtor ma la brtson par bya'o/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// rta 'grin dbang gi dngos grub brnyes// snang srid 'jig rten dbang du 'dus// lha srin sde brgyad bran du khol// phrin las gang brtsams thogs pa med// 'chi med rdo rje'i sku ru gyur// de phyir dbangachen rta mgrin gyi// sgrub thabs bye ba sa ya brtsams// la la mchog gi don (466)la dgongs// la la dregs pa gcun la dgongs// la la dgra bgegs 'dul la dgongs// 'di ni dgongs pa gcig tu dril// de dag kun gyi snying po yin// gsang sngags rig sngags gzugs sngags dang*// drag sngags kun gyi rno so yin// bya sla tshegs chung don chen 'di// rjes 'jug don du zab par gdams// ma spel rin chen gter du sbos// las can gcig dang 'phrad par shog

/ces shin tu zab par gdams nas dpal rta mchog rol pa'i sgrub thabs bya ba sa ya tsam gter du sbas pa'i nang nas bsngags pa don dang ldan pa/ bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig mtsho rgyal dang mnga' bdag gnyis las rje 'bangs gzhan la ma gnang bar mchims phu'i tshogs khang ka ba dbus mar gter du sbas pa/ phyis su mnga' bdag gi sprul pa nyang gis gter nas bton pa/ rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can sgrub pa lag tu blang thabs dpal rta mchog rol pa'i rgyud kyi dum bu nag po klu 'dul gyi rgyud nas byung ba la ched du bsngags pa ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs rje phrin las gcig bsdus nas// 'gro ba'i don mdzad spyan ras gzigs// gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs ston// zhi bas mi 'dul gdug pa can// tshar gcod rta mgrin nag por bstan// de nyid shin tu khros pa ni// gnod sbyin nag po lcags ral can// dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang*// gza' klu rgyal bsen gnyen por bstan// chos sku (467)zhi ba'i ngang nyid las// gdug pa 'dul phyir drag po'i sku// rta mgrin nag po zhes kyang bya// yak+sha nag po zhais kyang bya// gnod sbyin nag po zhes kyang bya// mgon po nag po zhes kyang bya// mahā kā la rta gdong zhal// thugs rje mtshungs med bla ma yin// byin rlabs myur mdzad yi dam yin// bstan pa bsrung phyir chos skyong yin// dgregs bsgral phyir las mkhan yin// 'di la rgyas bsdus 'ga' yod kyang*// dpa' bo gcig tu sgrub pa 'di// 'khor gyi rnam grangs nges med phyir// bkra shis rgyud ni 'jam sa yin// gnod sbyin dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// rang bzhin shugs kyis 'khor ba'i phyir// shin tu rno la myur ba yin// lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la// lha srin sde brgyad me ltar 'bar// skye bo dmu rgod rlung ltar 'tshubs// nad mug mtshon gsum chu ltar 'khrugs// glo bur bar chad thog ltar 'bebs// de tshe sngags 'chang sgrub pa po// dpa' bo g.yul ngor zhugs pa 'dra// de la dgos pa rnam pa gnyis// tshur la gang gis mi tshugs pa'i// go cha lta bu'i man ngag dgos// phar la gang yang mi btang ba'i// mtshon cha lta bu'i man ngag dgos// dgos pa gnyis po 'di med na// dpa' bo gcer bu mtshon med 'dra// g.yul ngor bzlog pa mchog tu dka'// de la dgos pa dang po ni/

go cha lta bu'i man ngag la/ khro chu lta bu'i rdzas dang gcig(468)/gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags dang gnyis// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gsum// lus ngag yid gsum bsrung ba gces// dang po rdzas la rnam pa gsum// byugs pa bdug pa bsrung ba gsum// byugs pa'i rdzas ni dgu yin te// btsan dug mu zi gu gul gsum// mkhan pa spru ba spyang tsher gsum// gla ba shing kun sgog skya dgu /gcig gsum lnga gsum dgu gsum dang*// nya stong brgyad gsum dus gnyan la// lus kun bkru zhing byug par bya// gnod byed gang gis nye mi nus// bdug pa'i rdzas la dgu gnyis bstan// btsan dug thang dug bong dug gsum// ra dug re lcag thang phrom drug /gla ba gu gul shing kun dgu /mu zi sdong ros rta bon gsum// ba tsha spang spos bshul tshil gsum// byil khyi spyang ki'i brun dang dgu dgu gnyis sbyar ba'i ril bu bsregs// bdugs pas gdon rnams 'bros par 'gyur// bsrung ba'i rdzas ni dgu gsum bstan// btsan dug bong nga thar nu gsum// ra dug re lcag thang phrom drug /a shwa ba bla spyang tsher dgu /dug sna dgu yi bsrung ba yin// mi khrag khyi khrag phag khrag gsum// rgya khrag mngal khrag rtsod khrag gsum// gri khrag bya rog spyang khrag dgu /khrag sna dgu yi bsrung ba yin// gla ba gu gul shing kun gsum// tsan dan spang spos sha chen drug /mu zi sdong ros rta bon dgu (469)/sman sna dgu yi bsrung ba yin// dgu gsum sbyar ba'i ril bu bya// g.yag nag rog po'i rwa co'am// gri rkang nang du byugs la 'chang*// gnod byed gang gis mthong mi 'gyur// mthong yang tshugs par mi 'gyur ro// zhes so/ gnyis pa sngags kyi bsrung ba 'og nas 'chad do/ gsum pa ting nge 'dzin gyis bsrung ba la/ sbyor ba dngos gzhi rjes kyi chos gsum las/ dang po la/ yo byad shaums dang cho ga'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/

dang po ni/ gnas khang mdzes par brgyan/ mañdzi'i khar khro'am zangs sam lcags kyi snod gang rung du 'bru zan gyi dpal bshos zur gsum pa rta mgos mtshan pa la 'khor bshos phran brgyad kyis bskor ba la bong bu ma gtogs pa'i sha snas brgyan/ mda' rgod sgro ma la dar nag la rta mgrin gyi sku bris pa zhig gtor mar btsug tsan dan gyi ral gri khru+u gang ba dang*/ seng ldeng gi phur ba mtho gang ba la sgrub sngags tshang bar bris/ mthing shog la btsang drug dang*/ tsan dug dang*/ gu gul gyi khrag mtshal dkar sbyar la/ sku dang sngags byang bsrung bzlog gi 'khor lo rnams dpe'u ris ltar bris la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ lan bdun brjod pas rab tu gnas pa la/ khro mchog dbang gi rgyal pos spyan gyis gzigs/ thugs rje dgongs pa chags nas bzhugs pa'i rten du gyur par bsam la/ gtor ma'i g.yas su ral gri/ g.yon du phur bu/ mchod (470)pa rnam lnga dang*/ sman raka dang rgyun gtor rnams kyi dkyil 'khor bsgor/ gzhan yang bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma rnams che chung mang nyung 'byor ba dang bstun la byang phyogs gsum/ nub phyogs gsum bshams/ gzhan rta mgrin gyi thang sku dang*/ rten byin can rnams gang yod bkram/ rnga dang thod rnga/ tshil chen spos dkar la sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshags su tshud par bya ba'o// gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i chos la 'jug pa dang sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis/ gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bzhin/ dang po phyogs dang gnas po gzhi bdag la gtsang gtor 'bul/ drag po mngon spyod kyi sdong grogs mdzod ces bka' bsgo ba ni/ gser skyems dkar gtor 'bru sna rnams/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshangs pa dang ni brgya byin lha// me lha gshin rje srin po klu// lung lha gnod sbyin dbang ldan dang*// sa bdag sa yi lha mo dang*// gzhi bdag gnas bdag grong bdag dang*// gnas po dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams// sgrub la sdong grogs mdzad pa'i phyir// zhi zhing byams pa'i thugs kyis byon// bdud rtsi skyems dang gtor ma rnams// ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlabs pas// 'dod pa'i longs spyod bsam mi khyab// gcig las (471)brgya stong grangs med pa// cir yang 'char ba 'di bzhais la// byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad sol// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po'i las// gang la ko long phrag dog dang*// gnod gdug gang yang zhi bar mdzod/

ces phrin las bcol/ gnyis pa bgegs bsam zhing mtshams gcod pa ni/ bgegs kyi gtor ma la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya chen ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum gyis byin brlab te nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas bsngos te/ hūm̐/ nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren tshogs// nga yi bka' las ma 'da' bar// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di longs la// 'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs// ci ste mi 'gro 'dug gyur na/ khro rgyal rta mgrin thugs khros nas// mtshon cha ral gri lcags kyu yis/ khyod kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams// rdul phran bzhin du brlag par byed// de bas rang ngang gnas su dengs/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces drag sngags rol mo'i tsha rngam (172)dang bcas gegs bskrad/ de nas mtshams bcad pa ni/ hūm̐/ nga yi dkyil 'khor bstan bya'i phyir// khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i// mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin bsrung*/ hūm̐/ steng yang rdo rje'i gur khang la// rdo rje'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi la// rdo rje'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams rdo rjes gtams pa yi// rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ de bzhin du/ steng yang 'khor lo'i gur khang la// 'khor lo'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang 'khor lo'i sa gzhi la// 'khor lo'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams 'khor los gtams pa yi// 'khor lo'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig oṃ tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang rgya gram gur khang la// rgya gram thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang rgya gram sa gzhi la/ rgya gram tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams rgya gram gtams pa yi// rgya gram mtshams las ma mda' zhig

oṃ nā nā badz+ra rak+ṣa (473)hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang be con gur khang la// be con thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang be con sa gzhi la// be con tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams be con gtams pa yi// be con mtshams las ma 'da' zhig oṃ daṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang ral gri'i gur khang la// ral gri'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs// 'og kyang ral gri'i sa gzhi la// ral gri'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams ral gri'i gtams pa yi// ral gri'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig oṃ khaṭag rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ steng yang dbyug to'i gur khang la// dbyug to'i thog dang ser chen 'bebs/ 'og kyang dbyug to'i sa gzhi la// dbyug to'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs// phyogs mtshams dbyug tos gtams pa yi/ dbyug to'i mtshams las ma 'da' zhig oṃ muṅga rak+sha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas/ bdag gi ba spu'i khung bu dang shangs kyi rlung khro bo 'chol ba'i tshogs dang*/ mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ mo dpung 'bar ba'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa (474)spros/ g.yas su bskor bas gnod byed thams cad tshar bcad nas rim pa bzhin du mtshon cha'i gur khang me dpung 'bar bas kun tu khyab par bsam mo/ 'di dag ni gter gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ma nor ba yin pas cho ga'i 'gros gzhan dang sbyar bar mi bya'o/ gnyis pa sbyor ba'i chos la drug gi dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bdag ni deng nas byang chub ma thob bar// bla ma dkon mchog yi dam lha// pad+ma dbang gi dkyil 'khor du// bdag gis 'jug cing bsgrub par bgyi/ zhes lan gsum bya'o/ gsum pa yan lag bdun pas tshogs bsags shing rgyud sbyong ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum thams cad kyi// bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dang*// rgyal ba ma lus sras dang bcas/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gror skyabs su mchi// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sdig pa'i tshogs rnams mthol lo bshags// bdag gzhan dge la yi rang ngo*// chos kyi 'khor lo (475)bskor bas bskul// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhug su gsol// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/

zhes lan gsum bya'o/ bzhi ba sdom pa bzung ba ni/ bla ma dpal chen he ru ka /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dgongs su gsol// sngon tshe rgyal bas thugs bskyed ltar// byang chub sems ni bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rigs mchog dam tshig kyang*// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog dam tshig kyang*// bdag gis brtan por= rin chen rigs mchog dam tshig kyang*/ bdag gis brtan por= pad+ma'i rigs mchog dam tshig kyang*// bdag gis brtan por= las kyi rigs mchog dam tshig kyang*// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ lnga pa byin dbab pa ni/ spos rol bcas/ hūm̐/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'jig rten nas// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rigs kyi yum dang bcas// rgyal ba'i srung mar gyur pa'i dam tshig can// mchod do bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// gzugs sku 'jigs (476)byed khro bo'i skur ston pa// rta mchog drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes brtser dgongs nas// sngags tshig bshugs pa'i brda yis spyan 'dren gyis// phyag rgya gar gyi brda yis g.yab 'dor na// dpal chen rta mgrin thugs kyis rjes dgongs la// thugs dam brda la dgongs te gshegs su gsol// dur khrod 'bar ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu gshegs su gsol// ci bgyi'i bka' nyan las kyi dkyil 'khor nas// dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad gshegs su gsol// sdom pa las la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rig 'dzin rtsal 'chang 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// byang chub sems kyi tshogs ni gangs ltar chags// rgyan cha gsar rnying tshogs ni sprin ltar gtibs// ta na ga na'i tshogs ni dbyings ltar gang*// rdo rje mched lcam lha dang lha mor rol// ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ni nam mkhar gtibs// rnal 'byor longs spyod che la spyan 'dren na// thugs dam brda la dgongs te gshegs nas kyang*// bla med sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/(477)

rtsa sngags mthar/ dz+nyā na a be sha ya a ā/ ces byin dbab bo/ drug pa mchod rdzas phyi nang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bdag gi thugs ka nas raṃ yaṃ khaṃ 'phros pas ye shes kyi me rlung chur gyur pas mchod rdzas kyi dngos 'dzin dri ma thams cad bsregs gtor sbyangs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las bhañdza 'bar ba'i yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su oṃ las phyi nang gsang ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan so so'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' rab byams gang ba rnams su gyur par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pad+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhup+pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai bi d+ya/ shab+da a hūm̐/ sman phud/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las thod pa'i snod du sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga la hūm̐ oṃ traṃ hrī āḥ muṃ laṃ maṃ paṃ taṃ rnams kyis mtshan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrī ṭha/ rak+ta/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod du ra las (478)dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug pa las/ khams gsum gyi rak+ta thams cad bsdus shing thim par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ hrī ṭha/ gtor ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: stong pa'i ngang las gtor gzhong a las ka pā la'i snod du gtor rdzas oṃ las 'dod yon lnga'i phung po zad mi shes pa'i gter du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā bā ling+ta te dz+wa bhā ling+ta ba la ba te gu h+ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrī ṭha/ zhes byin gyis brlab bo/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdun las/ dang po dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ skad cig dran rdzogs ting 'dzin gyis// gru gsum mthing nag dkyil 'khor du// bdag nyid khro bo rta mgrin sku// mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// spyan gsum mche ba rab tu gtsigs// g.yas pas sgrol byed ral gri yis// dgra gegs mgo lus dum bur phral/

g.yon pa 'dzin byed lcags kyu yis// dgra gegs ma lus srog snying 'dzin// zhabs gnyis (479)dgra bgegs ma lus mnan// sku la dar nag ber chen gsol// spyi gtsug rta mgo ljang zhur gdengs// rta skad drag po nam mkhar 'tsher/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du sdud// srid gsum ma lus zil gyis gnon// sku stod zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang*// sku smad stag lpags sham thabs gsol// thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal byas// ba spu'i gseb nas tshwa tshwa 'phro/ bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs// dbu skra gnam lcags ral pa can// ral pa bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas// khro chung dpag med phar 'phros pas// dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad de// tshur 'dus khro bo'i gur du gyur// bsrung bzlog bsad pa'i khro bo ni// rim pa gsum gyi tshul du bsam// bdag nyid dam tshig sems dpa' yi// thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni// nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag /gzi brjid ldan pa'i mtha' bskor du// rtsa sngags g.yas su 'khor (480)bar bsgom// 'od zer spro bsdu'i ting 'dzin gyis// snod bcud dngos po thams cad kun// me ri khro bo'i rang bzhin las// gnod byed ming yang med par bsam// sems nyid skye med stong gsal 'di// ye nas rang bzhin lha yi sku// dam tshig ye shes gnyis med la// bskyed bstim rgyas gdab mi 'tshal te// dran pa tsam gyis rdzogs pa ni// lta ba rgyab kyi lha zhes bya// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin ni// bsrung ba kun gyi mchog yin no/ zhes gsal gdab bo/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes khros pas dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad pa/ khro mchog dbang gi rgyal po spyan 'dren na// dbang gi rta skad 'tsher zhing gshegs su gsol/ rtsa sngagasamathar/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ gsum pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐/ bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ dgra bgegs dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// dbang gi rgyal po bcom ldan lha yi lha/ mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par (481)bzhugs su gsol/ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes pas dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur par bsam/ bzhi pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐/ chags med skyon bral pad+ma rigs kyi lha// klu+u dbang tshul gyis gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa// rab 'jigs bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar/ khro rgyal rta mgrin sku la phyag 'chal lo// na mo pu ru sha ya ho/ a ti pu ho/ pra ti dza ho/ zhes phyag bya'o/ lnga ba mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid las// 'dod pa'i yon tan ma 'gags rol par shar// me tog bdug spos snang gsal dri chab dang*// zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag sna tshogs dang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos la sogs/ ma 'gags thabs kyi mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe dhu pe ā lo ke ghan+dhe nai wi d+ya shab+da rū pa shab+da ghan+dhe ra sa spar+she dharmā dha tu pū dza ho/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ snod gtsang mar sha khrag (482)legs pa gang 'byor ba'i gtor ma la sman raka sbran te/ oṃ brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ āḥbarjod pas snod yangs shing rgya che bar bsam/ hūm̐ brjod pas gtor ma dgra gegs kyi sha khrag ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi chen por bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan bdun gyis brlab/ de nas skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du dpal rta mgrin nag po 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa byon nas gtor stegs kyi khar bzhugs par bsam la/ hūm̐/ dug gsum dgra gegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag dang*// dug lnga sman sbyar bdud rtsi chen po 'di// khro mchog dbang gi sku la mchod pa 'bul// srid gsum gdug pa 'dul phyir bzhes su gsol/

ma hā pū dza ho/ de nas khro bo'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ yak+sha nag po dgra gegs mā ra ya/ māṃ sa/ rak+ta/ tsit+ta/ go ro tsa na/ ba su ta/ keṃ ni ri ti/ bā liṃ ta kha raṃ kha hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ gzhung ni dngos bstan de dang spro na/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag pa yi/ (483)/rtsa brgyad yan lag stong la sbyar ba'i sman// rigs lnga dam tshig rnam pa lnga yi dngos// ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas chen po// rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dbang chen rta mchog dpal// bka' nyan phyi nang dregs pa 'khor bcas la// rnam dag dam tshig bdud rtsi mnyes mchod 'bul// bzhes nas mthu rtsal dbang gi dngos grub stsol/ rtsa sngags/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ hūm̐/ nyon mongs rtsa ba 'khor ba'i khrag chen po// srid gsum zhen pa ma lus sbyang ba'i phyir// dbang chen rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// khams gsum dbang du 'du ba'i dngos grub stsol/ rtsa sngags/ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi/ hūm̐/ gdug pa bsgral ba'i sha khrag phung po yi/ gtor ma 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab// dbang chen rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// srid gsum zil gyis gnon pa'i= rtsa sngags/ ma hā ba liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ drug pa bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos sku skye med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// longs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad cing*/(484)/'bar ba'i khro bo dbang gi skur sprul nas// 'jig rten dregs pa 'dul la phyag 'tshal bstod// sku mdog mthing ga chos nyid 'gyur ba med// dar nag ber chen snang srid zil gyis gnon/ spyi gtsug rta myos sna tshogs phrin las rdzogs// bdud 'dul nag po che la phyag 'tshal bstod// phyag g.yas ral gris dgra gegs rtsad nas gcod// g.yon pa lcags kyus ma rungs snying nas 'dren// lcags ral gseb nas khro chung sprul pa 'gyed// gnod sbyin gdug pa 'dul la=

zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba rab tu gcigs// spyan gsum khro gnyer smin ma glog stong 'gyu// dpal gyi chas ldan me dpung klong na 'gying*// rab jigs dpa'o che la= hūm̐ gi nga ros khams gsum dbang du sdud// phaṭa kyi 'brug sgras log lta ma rungs gnon// rta skad sgrogs pas dregs pa las la bskul// gsung mchog rig sngags rgyal la= thugs nyid spros dang bral ba'i rang bzhin las// ye shes lnga yi mdzad pa cir yang ston// thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya chen rol pa yi// yon tan phrin las rdzogs la phyag (485)'tshal bstod/ ces bstod nas/ yi dam ltar phrin las bcol ba ni/ hūm̐/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// thugs rjes dbang gis khro rgyal skur ston pa// gar gyi dbang phyug khro bo kun gyi rje// ye shes sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'khor dang bcas// bka' yi pho nya dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du// thugs dam dbang gis gtor ma 'di bzhes la// dam tshig dbang gis rnal 'byor bdag cag skyongs// byang chub lam gyi bar chad bsgral ba dang*// bstan pa bshig pa'i dgra bgegs la tshogs pa// bdud dang log par 'dren pa thams cad la// mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ ces bya'o/ bdun pa cho ga gzhan gyi 'gros kyi bzlas pa'o/ nyang lugs rta nag gi rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa gnam lcags lta bu'i sngags kyi bsrung ba ni/ bdag nyid khro bo'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thugs ye shes sems dpa' yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gzi brjid ldan pa gcig bsam/ hūm̐ gi mtha' bskor du rtsa ba'i sngags phreng dmar po 'od zer dang bcas pa (486)mgal me 'khor ba lta bu g.yas skor du dmar sga ra ra 'khor ba gcig tu gyur par bsam/ hūm̐ dang sngags kyi phreng ba las 'od zer me dpung gi tshwa tshwa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs/

'od zer ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir 'phros pas/ phyi snod 'jig rten gyi khams ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal sogs dngos por gyur tshad thams cad me ri dang me dpung du gyur/ nang bcud kyi sems can mi dang mi ma yin pa'i skye 'gro gzugs yod dang gzugs med thams cad khro bo'i rang bzhin du gyur nas sngags kyi rang sgra 'u ru ru sgrogs par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭa: ces bung ba tshang 'tshol ba ltar di ri ri bzla'o/ las sngags gnam lcags spu gri ni/ yak+sha nag po nṛ tri hur thum dza: gnod byed mā ra ya srog la rbad rbad/ snying la rbad rbad/ rtsa la rbad rbad/ khrag la rbad rbad/ sha la rbad rbad/ rus pa la rbad rbad/ klad pa la rbad rbad/ yid la rbad rbad/ tsit+ta zungs zungs/ tsit+ta rmug rmug tsit+ta phyungs phyungs/ tsit+ta gtub gtubs/ tsit+ta myogs(487)myogs/ tsit+ta thuṃ ril/ ya ya bh+yo bh+yo/ srog rtsa chod chod/ snying rtsa phyungs phyungs/ khaṃ khaṃ/ laṃ laṃ/ tshal bar rbad rbad/ dum bur rbud rbud/ thuṃ myogs baṃ ril mā ra ya rbad sod/ raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ u tsa ta ya phaṭa/ h+ya gṛ ba 'bru bcu gcig /rta mgrin rtsa ba'i sngags su bshad/ yak+sha nag po man chad ni// las sngags gnam lcags spu gri yin// nṛ tri dgra dang bgegs kyi srog /hur thum dza ni 'gugs pa'i sngags// gnod byed gang yin ming gi them// ces gsungs pas/ nṛ tṛ dgrabagegs kyi bla srog de la 'gugs bsod bsreg gtor 'joms pa lnga las/ ༈ hur thum dzaḥ'agugs pa/ gnod byed kyi ming them spel/ mchan/ gnod byed kyi ming them bye brag dgos su ni/ ya ma rak+sha che ge mo/ sngags la/ rā tsa rak+sha ban+de/ ru tre rak+sha skye bo/ rak+mo rak+sha bud med/ the'u rang rak+sha byis pa/ nā ga rak+sha pha tshan che ba/ ru tri rak+sha ma tshan che ba/ de ltar hur thum dzaḥ zhes sbyar/ ༈ gsod pa la yang gsum ste/ spyi dang khyad par thun mong ste/ mā ra ya ni spyir gsod pa/

rbad sngags brgyad po srog gi sngags te ral gris gsod pa/ tsit+ta zungs nas bh+yo'i bar gyi nyi shu rtsa brgyad rbad sngags te lcags kyus gsod pa ni khyad par gyi gsod pa/ srog rtsa chod nas rbad sod kyi bar gyi nyi shu rtsa dgu ni ral gri dang lcags kyu gnyis kas thun mong du gsod pa/(488)raṃ raṃ dz+wa la raṃ gyis bsreg pa/ u tsa ta yas bskrad cing gtor ba/ phaṭa kyis thams cad 'dzoms par byed pa'o/ 'di yis mi thub gang yang med// dper na gnam lcags spu gri 'dra// rno ba'i tshad ni me lta bu// myur ba'i tshad ni glog lta bu// rgod pa'i tshad ni thog lta bu// gtum pa'i tshad ni rbab lta bu// dgra dang bgegs dang byad ma dang*// nad kyi rigs dang gdon gyi rigs// gnyan rigs lhog pa thab kyi rigs// mdze shu 'brum pa skrang lhog dang*// smyo 'bogs brgyal nad la sogs pa// nang dang gang du btab pa ste// me dang rtswa sbur dpe bzhin du// bsreg cing rab tu bsreg par byed// rlung dang thal ba'i dpe bzhin du// gtor zhing rab tu gtor bar byed// drag sngags bstan pa mang yod kyang*/ rno myu+ur ldan pa 'di las med// 'di la rigs ni 'ga' yod kyang*// sngags 'grigs tshang ba 'di las med// ces so/ bsnyen pa'i dus su rtsa sngags rkyang pa bzla/ sgrub pa'i dus su rtsa sngags dang las sngags sbrel te bzla/ las sbyor dus las sngags rkyang ba bzla'o/ bsnyen dus bung ba tshang tshol 'dra zhes 'bru mi gsal bar bzla/ sgrub sngags me dpung 'bar ba 'dra zhes skad gdang drag la ngar che bar bzla/ las sngags ser chen 'bebs pa 'dra zhes drag la 'bru re re nas thon par bzla'o/ sngags kyi gnad la gsum yin te/ 'gal me 'khor ba lta bu ni/ rtsa ba'i lha snang thugs ka'i sngags phreng gsal theb nges par bzla/ ba thag khrid pa lta bu ni/ gtso bo'i zhal nas lte bar brgyud/ thugs ka'i sngags la do la'i bzlas

(489) pa'o/ me sgyogs 'phen pa lta bu ni/ las sngags kyi dmigs bzlas rnams so/ stod kyi las kyi gtso bo bsrung bzlog sad pa gsum yin pas/ dang po ni sgrub thabs rtsa bar/ gal te dmigs bya bsrung ba ni/ lus ngag yid gsum sbas pa gces// lus ni bsrung ba'i gur du sba/ ngag ni srog snying bar du sba// yid ni thig le'i dbus su sba// thun mong ma yin khyad par gnad// sus kyang mthong bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes khro bo'i gur khang gi nang du/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i spyi bor slob dpon/ pho rigs g.yas/ mo rigs g.yon/ bu dang chung ma mdun/ nor rdzas rnams rgyab tu gsal te/ bsrung bya rnams kyi mgrin pa nas ngag gi dbang po yi ge a yi rnam pa can du bsdus te/ thugs srog hūm̐ yig gi sngags phreng gi nang ngos srog dang snying po'i bar der a yig 'od kyi gong bu'i rnam pa can dang*/ bsrung bya'i snying gar rnam shes kyi ngo bo nṛ yig ljang gu hūm̐ gi thig le'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi dbus su sbas te bzla'o/ de ni rang gzhan gnyis ka bsrung ba'i khyad par yin la/ rang bsrung rdo rje'i rdzogs chen ni/

oṃ badz+ra kro dha h+ya gṛ ba hūm̐ phaṭa/ rang lus gnam lcags rdo rje ni// rtse dgu me 'bar tshwa tshwa 'phro// stong gsum khyab pa gcig tu bsam// lte bar ral gri'i 'khor lo ni// bsnol ma g.yas dang g.yon du 'khor/(490)///////////////////////byad ma gnod bye thams cad ni/ tshal ba dum bur gtubs par bsamam/ rdo rje blte ba'i khong seng du/ nyi ma zla ba nyis rim gyi/ gur khang sra zhing 'thug par bsam/ dbus su gru gsum mthing nag tu/ dgra bgegs byad ma mnan par bsam/ rang gi sems nyid skad gcig gis khro bo rta mgrin gsal ba las/ spro bsdu khro bo'i ting nge 'dzin gyis/ bsrung bzlog bsad gsum go rim bzhin/ gur khag rim pas shes par bya/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ gi thig le yi/ dbus su nyi zla kha sbyor du/ bsrung bya bsgom pa khyad par gnad/ ces sngangs bzla'o/ bsrung bzlog bad gsu go rim bzhin/ ces pas rang dang gzhan gyi bsrung dmigs spyi dang bye brag gong du bstan pa gnyis dang*/ 'dir bdag bskyed 'brel ba'i de gsum gyi dmigs pa ni/ rtsa bar/ gal te pha rol rbod gtong sogs/ gnod phyed bzlog cing bsad pa ni/ gnam sa lcags bsreg 'khor lo las/ me 'bar tshwa tshwa nang du 'phros/ tshu la bsreg cing 'khor bar bsam/ bdag gi bsrung ba'i gur khaṃ las/ me 'bar rlung 'tshub tshwa tshwa 'phro/ phye la bsrog cingagator bar bsam/ bar du gnod byed byad ma rnams/ brlag nas ming yang bder bsam/ bdag nyid dpal chen po dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i dbu skra gnam lcags kyi ral pa bsigs pa'i skra gseb nas rang 'dra ba'i khro chung bsam gyis mi (491)khyab pa 'phros/ bar chad kya log 'dren dgra bgegs thams cad tsher bcad nas rming med du byas/ khro bo rnams tshur 'dus te zhal nag du gzigs nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bar med du dkra nas bsrug ba'i las mdzad par bsam mo/ yang steng

'og bar gsum las khro tshung grangs med pa sprayos te zhal phyir gzigs nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ yang de'i phyi rol du lcags bsregs kyi 'khor lo drag po me dpung 'bar brtsanagayas g.yonan du shugs dragis 'khor ba las me'i tshwa tshwa nang du 'phros pa dang*/ nang gi bsrung bzlog gi khro bo'i sku las yag sprul khro chung mon pa cha sna tshogs pa thogs pa grangs med pa dang*/ bsreg byed 'bar ba'i zhugs phung las me'i tshwa tshwa shugs drag gi 'thor rlung dang bcas pa phyir 'phros pa'i bar du gnod byed rnams bsad bcad gtub cing bsreg gtor byas rdul du brlag nas bsad par bsam la/ rtsa sngags dngalas kya sbrel la bzla'o/ de ltar bsnyen rtsing grub pa'i rtags ni/ 'grub rtags rab 'bring tha ma gsum/ rab ni lha zhal mthong ba dang*/ rta mgo 'tsher dang rta skad thos/ rang gi rta skad 'byin pa dang*/ mi nag lcags skye ral pa can/ rta nag 'tsher zhing dngos sa 'ong*/ 'bring ni nyams dang snang ba la/ tha ma rmi lam dag tu 'ong*/ gnas khang brten rdzas (492) gtor ma la (492)gtor ma la/ me 'bar 'od 'phro dud pa 'thul/ tshogs sgra cho 'phrul chen po 'byung*/ rmi lam rtags kyi mdzad ma ni/ rdzogs chen brtsigs dang go khrab gyon/ 'khor gsum btags dang mtshon cha brdar/ me chen 'bar dang rlung chen 'tshubs/ rnge na brlung dang dung chena'abud/ dar chen phra dang dmag chen dpon/ phyogs las rgyal ba'i mtshon nyid yin/ mtshon cha mda' gzhu bcag pa dang*/ brag chen bshegs dang rdzogs chen phab/ pha wa rlog dang g.yag rgod bsad/ sha btson bzung dang glo snying ster/ dgra las rgyal ba'i mtshon nyid yin/ khrag zor gzir dang phur pa bdag ser ba bzlog dang prin na gtor/ sha 'ud chu zlog glog lce bcad/ byad las rgyal ba'i mtshon nyid yin/ mi nag khros dang rta nag bsad/ mdzo long dme spyang tshur la rgol/ mi mthun mdzad ma byung ba na// thugadam dam bskang zhing mnga' gsol bya/

bdun gsum gis nges par 'grub/ ces gsum so/ zher la mdzed yi nad gso na/ gal te blo rgya chung ba'am/ lus la gdon chesan zhugs pa na/ lte bar raṃ yig dmar po bsam/ raṃ las me 'bar lus (493) kun bsregs/ rang nyid med dpung chen por bsams/ raṃ gyi tshwa tshwa 'phros pa las/ me sgra sngags sgra sgog par bsam/ zhes sngags bzla'o/ de ltar gces gnad rnams nges par byas la tshul bzhin bzlas na dngos 'grub sa la slu ba yod re kan/gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la bdun las dang po tshags mchod bshams shing byin gyi brlab pa ni/ yo bya rnams la bdud ratsis bsang gtor byas te/ hūm̐: rdo rje bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ chos rnams thams cad sgyur mar rig byang chub sems nyid yi ge'i tshul/ rig pa'i ye shes raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ ra las ye shes me byung bas/ tshogs kyi 'bags rtsog thams cad bsregs/ yaṃ las ye shes rlung byung bas/ tshogs kyi ma dag thams cad gtor/ khaṃ las ye shes chu byung bas/ tshogs kyi gzung 'dzin thams cad bkrus/ raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ yaṃ sapha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ khaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ slar yang sku gsung thugs rdo rje/ oṃ dang āḥdang hūm̐ dag gsum/ phar 'phros snod bcud thams cad gang*/ tshur 'dus 'do du ste gyis zhu/ oṃ gyis mtshon ma'i rtogs pa sbyangs/ āḥyis (494)ye shes tshogs su spel/ hūm̐ gis re skong lhun gyis grub/ gang 'dod cir yang sprul zhing bsgyur/ oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ hā ra ṇa hūm̐/ āḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ 'uṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ gnyis pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: sngon tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ snang ba mtha' yas spyan snga ru/ thugs bskyed rnam dag rgya chen gyis/ thugs dam gnyen po zhal bzhes pa'i/ thugs rje chen po gsheg su gsol/ spyan ras gzigs dbang gshegs su gsol/ 'jig rten dbang phyug= gsang gi mgon po= gar gyi dbang phyug=

dbang gi rgyal po= h+ya gṛ wa= rta mgrin nag po= gnod sbyin nag po= yak+sha nag po gshegs = klu 'dul nag po= gza' 'dul nag po= bgegs 'dul nag po= sri 'dul nag po= dgra 'dul nag po= dpal myon nag po= legs ldan nag po= bstan srung nag po= las mkhan nag po= srog bdaganag po= mon pa nag po= sprul pa nag po= yang sprulanag po= bka' nyan pho nya= dregs pa pho (495)mo= lha srin sde brgyad= bstan pa bsrung phyir= dgra bgegs 'dul phyir= thugs dam bskang phyir= sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ sgrub tsing mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru// dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ khyed la phyag 'tshal mchod pa 'bul/ thugs dam gnyen po bskang gyur cig gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul zhing thugs dam bskang ba ni/ gzugs sgra dri re reg ldan pa'i/ 'a'adod don tshogs kyi macod pa ni/ gus pa'i blo yis 'bul lags na/ dgyes pa'i gar gyis bzhes su gsol/ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hi/ de nas thugs dam bskong ba ni/ hūm̐ spyan gyi dbango tshom sib phyir/ sna tshogs gzugs kis thugs dam bskang*// snyan gyi dbang po tshim pa'i phyir/ sna tshogs sgra yis thugs dam bskang*/ shangs kyi dbag po tshim= sna tshogs dri yis= ljangs kyi dbag po tshim= sna tshogs ro yis= sku yi dbag po tshim pa'i= sna tshogs reg byas= thugs kyi dbag po= sna tshogs chos kyis= phyi ya bar chad zhi ba'i phyir/ phyi yi mchod pas thugs dam bskang*/ tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i phyir (496)nang gi chod pas thugs dam bskang*/ snag ba dbag du sdus pa'i= gsang ba'i mchod pas= dgra bgegs ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir= sha khrag dmar gyis= sgrub la dngos grub ster ba'i phyir/ bdud rtsi sman gyis= dbang dang byin rlabs 'bebs pa'i phyir/ dmar chen rak+tas= sna tshogs prin las mdzad pa'i phyir/ dam tshos gtor mas thugs dam bskang*/ bsod nams phun tshogs pa'i= longs spyod tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang*/

hūm̐: 'gro drug thabs kyis 'dren pa'i phyir// thugs rje chen po'i thugs dam bskang*// ye shes phyogs med rgyas pa'i phyir// spyan ras gzigs kyi= 'khor 'das chos la dbang bsgyur= 'jig rten dbang phyug= gsung gi phrin las garub pa'i= gsung gi dbang phyug= gang la gang 'dul ston= gar gyi dbang phyug= khyad par dbang gi las mdzad phyir/ dbang gi rgyal po'i= thugs rje khros pa'i gar mdzad phyir/ h+ya gṛ wa'i= 'jig rten dregs pa tshar gcod phyir/ rta mgrin nag po'i= gdug pa ma lus 'dul ba'i= gnod sbyan nag po'i= rgyal bsen pho mo 'dul ba'i phyir= yak+sha nag po'i= 'chi bdag pho mo (497)'dul ba'i phyir/ bdud 'dul nag po'i= gdol ba pho mo= klu 'dul nag po'i= drang srog pho mo 'dul= gza' 'dul nag po'i= sa bdag klu gnyan 'dul ba'i phyir/ gdod 'dul nag po'i= ma ye shes thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir/ bgegs 'dul ga po'i= dam sri thams cad 'dul ba'i phyir/ sri 'dul nag po'i= sdang dgra thams cad 'dul ba'i= dgra 'dul nag po'i= sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i= dpal ldan myon po'i= lha min g.yul ngo bzlog pa'a'i= leg ldan nag po'i= bstan pa'i ru tra bsgral ba'i phyir/ srung ma nag po'i= drag po'i las la mnga' mdzad= las mkhan ga po'i= tshe dang srog la mnga' mdzad pyir/ srog bdud nag po'i= gsod gcod la mnga'= shan pa nag po'i= sha dang khrag la mtha'= mon pa nag po'i= stong gsum dgra gegs 'dul ba'i phyir/ spul pa nag po'i= bdudan rgyud rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir/ yang spul nag po'i= gtso ba'i bka' bzhin bsgrub pa'i phyir bka' nyan pho nya'i= dpal gyi (498)bka' bstod yin pa'i phyir/ dregs pa pho mo'i= bka' dag dam la gnas pa'i phyir/ lha srin sde brgyad= mchod nas dge ba'i dgra gegs mdzad phyir/ yul lha zo dor= khyed kyi thugs dam gyur nas/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas kyi/ dam tshig nyam chags bskang gyur cig

chags che nyams nga med par mdzod/ ston gyi las dag 'phral gyi rgyen/ mi mthun phyogs rnams zhi bar mdod/ tshe dang longs spyod spel ba dang*/ 'khor dang bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ snang ba dbang du 'du ba dang*/ bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ phyi nang bar tshad bzlog tu gsol/ bin rlabs mthu rtsal chen po dang*/ dbang drag phrin las thog ltar phob/ dgra la rbad na dgra dpung chom/ bgegs la rbad na bgegs dpung tul/ gdon la rbad na gdon rkung phud/ lus gdon na gdon rtsad nas chod/ god 'dre yul 'dre phug nas spyungs/ de sri pho mo tshang nas thon/ sa bdag lu gnyan snying nas drongs/ rgyal bsen 'byung po spyi nas chom/ gza' gdon thams cad rdul du (499)rlog b+da ma rang gshed rang la phob/ nad pa yod na mal nas slong sri'u yod na tshang nas skyed/ shi kha chod la god kha sdoṃ/ mi kha sgur la ye shes kha zlog dus la bab po sa ma ya/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ zhi ba bar bshags ni/ thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// sgo gsum mi shes bag med pas// nyams chags 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ de da thams cad bshags par bgyi/ hūm̐: thugs rje chen po gsan cing dgongs su gsol/ byams myon thugs rje pyogs ris ma mnga' yang*// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon lam mtha' yas kyis/ zhi la zhi dag khro la khro bo sogs// gang la gang 'dul de la der sgon cing*// phrin las rnam bzhi 'gro ba thabs kyis 'dul// ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te/ bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa/ byams myon thugs rje can la bzod thar gsol/ bzod par gsol lo tshangs par stsal gdu gsol/ hūm̐: rta mgrin nag po gsan cing dgongs su gsol// chos kyi sku la byams sdang (500)mi mnga' yang*// gdug pa 'dul phyar khro bo'i skur ston pa/ dbag drag stobs kyis tshar gcod rjes 'dzin mdzad/ shin tu khros pa gnod sbyin nag po'i gzugs/

gnam lcags ral pas tong khams mdun ltar gtibs/ chos nyid yangs pas 'jig rten lto bar mabacug /snying rjes rngam pas 'gro drug zhal du gsol// ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te/ bag med tshul gyis dam las 'gal gyur pa// 'phags mtshog spyan ras gzigs la bzo rol/ bzo thar gsol lo= hūm̐ḥ yak+sha nag po gsan cing dgong su gsol/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngag las ma g.yos kyang*/ thugs rje'i dbang gis ma rung tshar gcod phyir/ shin du mi bzad gnod sbyin gdug pa can/ khro gtum srin po'i cha lugs srog la rngams// rab 'jigs dreng pa'i 'khor tshogs las la 'gyed/ bstan pa bsrug pyir bka' yi bya ra mdzad/ dkar po'i phyaugs skyog nag po'i phyogs rnamasa'adzoms/ ma rig dbang gis de ltar ma rtogs te/ bag med tshul gyis= dbang chen dregs pa 'dul la bzo thar =(501)bzod thar gsol lo= hūm̐: gsang sngags gnyan po'i sgor zhugs rnal 'byor pas/ shes bzhin mi ldan bag med dbang gyur pas// sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags/ gsung gi= thugs kyi= rtsa ba'i= yan lag= sdom pa spyi dang 'gal ba= bka' lung dbang dang mi ldan= dam tshig snod dang mi ldan= man ngag bcu dang mi ldan= ya dam blang dor byas pa= bsnyen sgrub par byas papa= bskyed rim ti ngas 'dzin ma gsal= rdzogs rim dgongs pa ma rdzogs= bzla brjod snying po ma rgyal= phrin las gzung bzhin ma bsrang= mchod pa lo zlar 'das pa= tshogs dag gtor ma chags pa= dus dang dus las 'das pa= mthol lo bshags so bla ma yi dam lha/ gnod do 'gyod do dpa' 'o mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ bzod par gsol lo srung ma dam tshig can/ tshangs par stsol cig badz+ra sa ma yā/ a āḥ lnga ba bsgral zhing bstab pa ni/ tshogs tha la'am dmigs bya'i rū pa bcas la bden stobs brjod nas dmigs bya 'gugs bstim bya/ hūm̐/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta macog dpal/ (502)'khor dang bcas pa'i dus la babs/ gdug can dgra dang bgegs kyi tshogs/

kug cig a kar+sha a dzaḥ phur bu 'bar bas srog rtsa chod/ sna tshogs mtshon chas dum bur gtubs/ rdo rje tho bas rdul du bcom/ rma shes skye med dbyings su drongs/ nṛ tri sa talan mā ra ya rbad/ snyigs ma'i sha khrag bdud ratsir spel la stob pa ni/ dgra gegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus/ don snying nang khrol bcas pa rnams/ ye shes bdud rtsir byin rlabs nas/ bzhes shig rol cig dgyes par mdzod/ māṃ sa rak+ta keṃ ni ri ti khā hi/ zhes 'bul/ de nas tshags rdzas rnams brda dang brdī 'bul len gyis dam tshig bsre ba sngon du 'gro bas tshogs la rol/ drug pa lhag ma rnams bsdus la kha sprus bdud rtsir spel te/ hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi gzhal yas nas/ zhi ba'i bud med dkar mo ni/ dkar mo 'bum gyi dbus na bzhugs// phyag na dung gi gzhong pa sogs/ las su dpal gyi lhag slud ma/ don gyi sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*/ sgru pa po la phan gdags phyir/ bran gyi tshul du khas blangs pas (403)lhag ma'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyi/ nad bgaigs rnams zhi ba dang*/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ hūm̐: rin chen sdig kyi gzhal yas nas/ rgya pa'i bud med ser mo ni/ ser mo 'buṃ gyi= phyag na gser gyi= las su dpal gyi= don gyi sangs rgyas yin= sgrub pa po la= bran gyi tshul du khas blangs= lhag ma'i= bdag cag= tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa dang*/ bcol pa'i= hūm̐: pad+ma rigs kyi gzhal yas nas/ dbang gi bu med dmar mo ni/ dmar mo 'bum gyi= phyag na bye ru'i gzhong pa= las su= don gyi sangs rgyas= sgrub pa po la= bran gyi= lhagam ma'i= bdag cag= lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdus/ bcol ba'i= hūm̐ḥ las kyi rigs kyi gzhal yas nas/ drag po'i bu med sngon mo ni/ sngon mo 'bum gyi= phyag na g.yu yi= las su= don gyi= sgrub pa= bran gyi= lhag ma'i= bdag cag= dgra bgegs thams cad drag pos bzlog

de nas lhag ma'i phrin las btsol (504)be ni/ bh+yo: yas kyi sri ru langs pa yang*/ dmar chen bka' yi gtor mas bzlog mas kyi yang na sri langs kyang*/ dmar chen bka'= bar pa la ni btsan kus kyang*/ dmar chen= bh+yo bh+yo sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo gnod pa'i bges la bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo bar rten la= gtor ma 'di dang dgra bo gnyis gnyam por zhes la drag shul bskyed/ myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod/ ces lhag ma dang mnyam du drog po'i phrin las bcol ba man ngag gab sa mngon phyung yin/ bdun pa thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐: gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ dgra bgegs dregs pa snol ba'i gdan steng nas/ rta mgrin nag po sku bzhengs shig yak+sha nag po= gnod sbyin nag po= las mkhan nag po= bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ bskul lo yak+sha mthu bo che/ rbad do dam nyams dgra la rbad/ ma g.yel srug ma thugs da can/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa khyod kyis bsrungs/ dkon mchog dbu 'phang khyod kyis bstod/ rnal 'byor sku tshe (505)khyed kyis bsrings/ yon bdag bar chad khyed kyis sol/ sdag ba'i dgra la rtags phyungs shig /gnod pa'i bgegs la las mdzod cig khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdod/ ces bskul lo/ brgyad pa chad tho bsgrags pa ni/ cos skyong gtor ma sogs gtor stogs nas blang la stegs ma bkod/ sman raka brags 'bru gsum byes bdud rtsir spral la*/ bh+ruṃ rat+na bi ma na bh+ruṃ/ traṃ rat+na bha liṃ ta tram̐/ gtor gzheng rin po che'i snod du gtor ma ri po che'i mchod rdzas 'bar bar gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐/ yul gy-i nga ni o rgyan yul/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling du/ pad+ma ge sar sdong po la/ ya mtshan ma chog gi dngos grub brnes/ bla ma mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// dbang chen rta mgrin skur bzhengs tshe// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mngapor bskor/

dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad du/ brtul zhugs spyod pa brgyag ba'i tshe/ lha srin sde brgyad bran du bkol/ gsang mtshan rdo rje drag po rtsal/ bod yul dbus su byon pa'i tshe/ stag tshang seṅge bsam 'grub tu/ mtha' dbus 'bayung po thams cad btul (506)rig 'dzin rdo rje gro bo lod/ bdag ni slob dpon de yi rgyud/ khyed rnams lha 'dre yal gam can/ ma myon rgyal man chad nas/ mgu lha dge bsnyen yan chad/ bstan 'dzin skyong ma ya ma'i tshogs/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs las la 'dus/ rgyan gyi gtor mas thugs dam/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgugs/ bsad dang bskrad dang mnan pa sogs/ gang la bya ba khyod shes kyis/ bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod/ sarba dharam pā la ma dhā ki ni hring hing ba ling ta kha hi khā hi/ ces gtor ma gtsang par btang*/ dgu ba brtan ma brkyang ba ni/ bh+yo: slob dpon pad+ma thod phreg gi bka' nyan ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs/ dam rdzas dpal gyi gtor ma longs/ bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mamadzod/ ces pyir 'bul lo/ bcu palarta bro ni// gtor gzhung sbubs pa ri rab tu gsal ba'i 'og tu dam sri mnan par bsam la/ hūm̐/ dgra gegs bsgral ba'i phung po la/ dpa' bo chen pos bro brdungal bas/ phyogs bcu rnam mkha'i khams gag nas/ khro bo'i tshogs dang khro mo'i tshogs/ ma sring tshogs dang pho nya'i tshogs (507)bro la gshegs po chems se chem/ hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin khros pa'i sku/ rta skad lan gsum steng du sgrog/ dang pos sa steng 'dzin g.yo/ g.yo/ gnyis pas gzugs khams dbang du sdud/ gsum pas 'dod khams zil gyis gnon/ 'di ni rta mgrin brtul zhugs yin/ hūm̐: nga ni rta mgrin khros pa'i sku/ dug gsum dgra gegs zhabs su mnan/ zhe sdang pho rgyud g.yas su mnan/ 'dod chags mo rgyud g.yon du mnan/ gti mug rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod/ 'di ni pho nya'i phrin las yin/ sdang ba'i dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs/

byad ma dam sri gdon gyi tshogs/ zhabs kyi 'og tu rdul phran bzhin/ ra mgrin khros pa'i tshogs kyi brdung*/ ye shes ri rab lcing gyis (508)gnon/ drag sngags rdo rja'i mtshon gyis bsnun/ gzi brjid med dpung zer gyis bsregs/ rid pa las kyi rlung gis gtor/ ji srid bskal pa ma rdzogs par/ dag gegs sdang bar ma byed cig rtsa sngags/ sarba sharlun s+t+waṃ bha ya nan/ zhes khro bo'i stangs stabs kyi khro bya'o/ bcu gcig sa thun bsdu ba ni/ slar mchod cing bstod nas/ yig brgya mang du bzla/ bdag ni ma rig sku la bzod par gsol/ gyis bzod par gsol nas/ mdun rten la bzhugs su gsol nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rag yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gyen rdzogs mi dmigs pa'i ngag la mnyam par bzhag slar yang*/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa ces brjod pas/ skad cig gis dpal ta mgrin gyi skur gsal ba'i gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan (509) par gyur/ bcu gnyis pa smon lam ni/ khro bo rta mgrin dgongs su gsol/ khyed la mchod bstod bgyis pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ mchu cod dang thun mongs dngos grub kun thob nas/ dbang dang 'gugs bsgral mnan gzir logs pa/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bcu gsum pa bsngo smon lam ni/ dge ba 'di yas mayur du bdag/ khro bo rta mgrin 'a'agrub gyur nas/ 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ de yi sa la 'god par shog bcu gnyis pa bkra shis ni/ hūm̐: bla ma dpal chen he ru ka'i/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs kyis/ mchog thun dngos grub thob nas kyang*/ phrin las thogs med bkra shis shog zhes shis pa brjod pa tsi rigs pas mtha' rgyas par bya'o/ kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gis leg gsungs pa'i/ nā ga kyu 'dul rgyud nas legs btus pa/ o rgyan mkhan po'i thugs kyi brnog chos su/

chos rgyal rje dang mtsho rgyal nyid la gdams/ shig tu zab pas gter du rgyas btab pa/ mnga' sprul pa nyi mam 'od zer gyis/ mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod mchims pu'i gter gnas nas/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i (510) cha rkyen du/ gdan dudrangs ba'i zab chod khyad par can/ sngon gyi dus na lam 'di'i rnal 'byor gyis/ mchog thun dngos grub brnes pa zhing 'di'i khyon/ gang bar thon zhes nyid zla ltar grags kyang*/ deng sang snyigs ma'i mngon rtogs mthu che bas/ mtshan tsam thos pa srid mthar gyur pa na/ lha mchog 'di la skyed dang tshor bas su/ 'brel ba'i rnam dkar bag chags rjes sad pa/ sngags rigs 'dzin sa pad+ma las brel gyis/ rgyud don zab mo'i gnad rnams phyogs gcig tu/ bsdus nas man ngag lag len bde bar bsdebs/ dge ba 'di yi bdag dang 'gro ba kun/ dbang chen rta mchog rol bas rjes bzangs te/ byang chub lam bye bar chad mthar byas nas/ 'phags mchog khyed dgongs spyod mnyam par shog ces pa'ang dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi phrin las kyi byang bu 'dod 'jo'i snyi ma zhes ba ba lam 'di la mos pas 'jug lam du byed pa pasma las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa dge'o/// /
